name: Aten International Co., Ltd
summary: Aten International Co., Ltd manufactures and trades computer peripheral, wired and wireless communication equipment, and electronic modules and parts in Taiwan, the United States, Japan, South Korea, China, and internationally. It operates through Electronic Peripherals and Specialized Printing segments. The company also offers cable, Cat 5, desktop, rack, over IP and IP matrix, extenders, matrix, and secure KVM switches; LCD KVM switches/consoles, computer sharing devices, management software/control center, remote control and monitoring solutions, serial console server, and KVM modules and accessories.
